name: io.github.Lukasz-Juranek/usb-servo-controller
title: USB Servo Controller
description: Drive 12 hobby servos on an open-hardware USB-C controller: moves, poses, sequences, rail current

packageArguments.name: --port
packageArguments.description: Serial port of the board, e.g. COM5 or /dev/ttyACM0. Auto-detected when omitted.

packageArguments.name: --config
packageArguments.description: Path to servogui.json from the GUI: channel names, travel limits, poses and sequences.
